text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.1752 for the Senior C++ Engineer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications includes that they "Built REST APIs," listed C++, and have experience with AWS and Machine Learning. Key gaps include a lack of experience with boost, linux, relational databases, and non-relational databases, as well as a total of 1.54 years of experience. This application has been escalated for manual review due to the candidate's location, missing must-have requirements, and a low overall fit score.
